name: fivem-mcp
description: FiveAI FiveM debug MCP - the single workspace package: server resource, client binding and MCP contracts.

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck:http && pnpm run build:http
scripts.build:entry: pnpm run build:identity && esbuild src/cli/entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/entry.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('src/cli/windows-files.ps1', 'dist/windows-files.ps1')"
scripts.build:broker: pnpm run build:identity && esbuild src/broker/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/broker.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:legacy: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm run build:entry && pnpm run build:broker && pnpm run build:bundle
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck:http && node --test tests/fixture-isolation.test.mjs tests/build-identity.test.mjs tests/http-*.test.mjs
